objective: B112: the shared-line locality of two points re-tested on fresh composites, then a proof attempt.
status: Refuted 2026-11-10 (computed, pre-registered): the frozen prediction that every pair of disturbances at distance 2 or more combines failed on one of 1,200 fresh pairs (one point's repair reached a line through the other); proved instead by hand that disturbances with disjoint supports combine in every order and end at the floor.
title: Points interact only through a shared line
